tools.name: list-mailing-products
tools.description: Lists the direct mail products Vogelaar sells online (card/selfmailer, mailing in envelope, brochure in film): a short explanation, the print runs, a price indication per print run and the link to the online configurator. Prices are public webshop prices in EUR excl. VAT, including printing, address

tools.name: get-mailing-product
tools.description: Returns one mailing product with all its steps and choices (format, paper, fold, envelope, ...), an explanation per step, the default selection, the PostNL delivery speeds and, for a mailing in envelope, the items that can go in the envelope.

tools.name: calculate-mailing-price
tools.description: Calculates the exact price of a mailing composition: one total for printing, addressing, processing and PostNL postage (public webshop prices, EUR excl. VAT), with the expected delivery days per speed, the weight and the postal format. When a combination is not possible, valid is false and problems

tools.name: create-mailing-order
tools.description: Prepares an order in the Vogelaar webshop for a mailing composition and returns a personal link. On that page the customer uploads the print file and address file (now or later), enters company and contact details and pays with iDEAL, or logs in to order on account. Nothing is ordered or paid until

tools.name: request-mailing-quote
tools.description: Sends a quote request to Vogelaar sales for work the webshop does not cover: large or recurring mailings, periodicals, personalised letters, fulfilment, special formats or advice. It creates a lead with the given name, e-mail address and message; a Vogelaar account manager contacts the person, usual
